clips.title: The story
paras: In Mulgore, young tauren hunters are sent to Bloodhoof Village for advanced training. There, they seek Yaw Sharpmane and begin the trials of taming and bonding with wild beasts.

Among the Shu'halo, hunting is sacred. A hunter learns the balance of nature, honors the spirits of the plains, and respects the animals that sustain the tribes. When young hunters prove they can survive in the wild and use a bow or gun, their elders send them to seasoned mentors. That journey marks their step beyond solitary tracking and toward adulthood in tauren culture.

The road crosses Mulgore's grasslands to Bloodhoof Village, beside Stonebull Lake. There, Yaw Sharpmane teaches hunters about the local beasts. Meeting him marks a hunter's readiness for the trials of beast taming, where they learn to commune with predators as well as hunt them.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.
You must see Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village. He can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, I do believe you are ready...
